integrity: Analytical geometric proof and a self-contained exact finite graph enumeration/derivative checker; numerical checks do not establish all analytic statements. No independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Full order-three polyanalytic Fock space in one variable, exactly four orthogonal normalized evaluations; one-node first-order Gaussian-normalized Gram-operator jitter only. The underlying planar two-distance configurations are classical; the proposed quantitative contribution is the sensitivity and its reversal of aperture optimality. Independent priority unverified.
title: Aperture versus jitter in four-point orthogonal polyanalytic Fock designs
